## BNullParameter

The [`BNullParameter`](BNullParameter.md "BNullParameter") class represents a junction or I/O point in the parameter web. It doesn't take any value; instead, it's used primarily to identify special places in the parameter web that need to be displayed specially by the client application.

Typical uses of [`BNullParameter`](BNullParameter.md "BNullParameter")s are to identify where signals enter or leave the node (input and output jacks, ADCs or DACs, and so forth).
